messages.subject: examples
parts:
Also, I wonder if we need to add some warnings in the examples. For example, in "blocker", the following comment line:

# We don't recommend the inv_gamma prior, we only use it to be the same as the already existing Bugs model.

messages.author: 38fb189d6a450638
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] examples
parts: Maybe, but we need to be mindful of newcomers… on one extreme, we'd rewrite every example "the way Andrew [would do / will do in BDA3]"; at a minimum though, a link to the 'prior distributions for variance parameters' paper and a mention of the folded-t. Saying "x is an example, but don't do x" is frustrating!
